name: EMB Mission Bound AB (publ)
summary: Based in Stockholm, Sweden, EMB Mission Bound AB (publ) specializes in the creation, development, and promotion of digital slot machines for gaming operators worldwide, with a strong focus on the Asian market. Established in 2019, their comprehensive service offering includes slot game and platform development, white-label solutions, game content aggregation, payment system integration, UI/UX design, and digital marketing. The company adopted its current name, EMB Mission Bound AB (publ), in January 2025, having previously operated as Embark Group AB (publ).
